sentences.text:
= =
 Appearance :
 For the Petitioner/s : Mr.Ajatshatru  Mr. Dilip Kumar Shah  For the Respondent/s : Mr.Raj Kishore Roy -Gp18  ======================================================
 CORAM: HONOURABLE MR. JUSTICE RAJIV ROY  ORAL ORDER 4 02-09-2025 Heard the parties.

2. The present petition has been preferred for the following relief(s):
"To issue a writ in the nature of MANDAMUS/ CERTIORARI or any other writ or direction commanding the respondents to pay the compensation of acquired land following the provisions contained in section 24 to 30, 40, 69, 80 & 96 of Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency In Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 30 of 2013 [Hereinafter mentioned as "The Act"] of Award no. 38 (Ja) of L.A. case no. 4/2009-10 [Ann-2], Further the Petitioner prays for direction to respondents to enumerate the market value of land as on the date of implementation of "the Act" i.e. 1.1.2014 as mentioned in The Act as well as under letter dated Patna High Court CWJC No.14568 of 2017(4) dt.02-09-2025 26.10.2015 & 4.12.2015 [Ann-5 & 6], Further prayer to pay the additional compensation of 75% as per section 40 (5) of the Act as well as letter dated 7.12.2016 [Ann-8] because the land has been acquired under emergent provisions, Further the Petitioner prays for direction to pay the amount @12% per annum as contained in section 30 (3) of the Act, Further Mangal Prasad vs The State Of Bihar And Ors on 2 September, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/95363589/
1 prayer for direction to respondents to pay the interest u/s 80 of the Act and be further pleased to issue any further direction/directions to the respondents in view of the facts and circumstances of this case."

entities.text: Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency In Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 30 of 2013
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text: 2. The land has been taken by the State for the construction of bus stand at Pahari, Patna and the grievance is that payment has not been made as per the market value and/or according to the Act.

3. The counter affidavit of the Respondents No. 3 and 4 has come justifying the award.
4.
This Court is of the opinion that an award has been prepared, payment has been made.
If the petitioner is aggrieved, he can approach the Arbitrator-cum-Divisional Commissioner, Patna for the redressal of the grievance.
5. Learned counsel for the petitioner submits that he shall be approaching the concerned Arbitrator in next eight weeks.

If such a petition is preferred, the authorities shall see to it that the matter was pending before this Court for eight long years while Patna High Court CWJC No.14568 of 2017(4)
dt.02-09-2025 deciding the limitation petition and the matter has to be heard on merit.
6. All issues that the petitioner wants to raise shall be taken note of before an order is passed.
7. This writ petition is disposed of.

(Rajiv Roy, J) Saif/-
U Mangal Prasad vs The State Of Bihar And Ors on 2 September, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/95363589/
